instructions_to_main_agent: Build the one-page app in standard React (.js files) using Tailwind CSS and Radix/Lucide icons.
Do NOT include any search bar or search icon in the header or anywhere else on the page.
Implement bilingual state toggle (EN / AR) that updates text content smoothly and toggles dir='rtl' on the container element for proper Arabic layout flow.
Use Three.js / React Three Fiber for a floating 3D stage geometry visual in the Hero background.
Ensure section balance: dark purple hero & services, soft off-white mauve about & portfolio cards, creating high contrast and dynamic rhythm without gloom.
Every interactive element (inputs, buttons, cards, language switch, profile download) MUST have its designated data-testid attribute.
Use sonner for toast notifications on contact form submission and company profile download button.
